description: This file defines an interface 'BracketedUnivariateSolver' for univariate root-finding algorithms that maintain a bracketing interval encapsulating a root. It specifies methods for solving equations within an interval, with options for starting points and allowed solution types.

classes.name: BracketedUnivariateSolver
classes.description: An interface for root-finding algorithms that maintain a bracketing interval for a univariate function, with methods to solve within a specified interval.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Finds a root within the specified interval, given maximum evaluations, the function to solve, interval bounds, and the allowed solution type.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Finds a root within the specified interval, starting from an initial value, with constraints and allowed solution type.
